'''Hard wheat''' is an [[aboveground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[Mill|milled]] into [[Flour|hard wheat flour]] or [[Still|brewed]] into [[Alcohol|hard wheat beer]].

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] hard wheat for its ''beer''.
